genres.tagline: Gods, monsters and heroes from ancient China and East Asia
Real people who changed China, told as stories
Crimes, clues and a detective to follow
Offices, colleagues and everyday city life
Two people, and what grows between them
This week's news and market moves, made readable

stories.title: 安娜的第一周
stories.blurb_en: A foreign newcomer at a Shanghai company learns what "收到", "辛苦了" and "改天请你吃饭" really mean.
stories.blurb_zh: 外国新人安娜来到上海一家公司，学会了“收到”“辛苦了”和“改天请你吃饭”的真正意思。
chapter_titles: 第二章 第一次饭局

stories.title: 月光成灰
stories.blurb_en: A demon lord banishes the priestess he married, believing she has betrayed him. The spell he feared was the one that saves his life.
stories.blurb_zh: 魔君以为妻子背叛了他，把她赶走了。后来救了他一命的，正是他害怕的那道光。
chapter_titles: 第三章 戴面纱的人

stories.title: 包公与牛舌头
stories.title_en: Judge Bao and the Ox's Tongue
stories.blurb_en: Someone cut out a farmer's ox's tongue. Judge Bao catches the culprit without asking a single question.
stories.blurb_zh: 有人割了农民的牛舌头。包公一个问题都没问，就让坏人自己跳了出来。

stories.title: 嫦娥奔月
stories.blurb_en: One dose of magic medicine, two people who love each other, and a thief at the door.
stories.blurb_zh: 一颗仙药，两个相爱的人，还有一个想偷药的小人。

stories.title: 孔子挨饿的那几天
stories.blurb_en: Lost, surrounded and out of food, his students start to lose their tempers. Confucius plays music.
stories.blurb_zh: 迷路、被围、没有饭吃，学生们都生气了，孔子却还在弹琴唱歌。

mid.title: 孔子挨饿的那几天
mid.blurb_zh: 走错了路，又没有饭吃，学生们都生气了，孔子却还在唱歌。

stories.title: 合同未婚夫
stories.blurb_en: A lawyer hires an actor to be her fiancé for the seven days of Spring Festival. He has his own reason for wanting to enter her family's house.
stories.blurb_zh: 律师林知夏花钱雇了一个演员，陪她回家过年。合同写了七天，可他来这里，并不是为了钱。
chapter_titles: 第三章 另一份合同
第十章 无固定期限

stories.title: 大雨里的外卖
stories.blurb_en: A rider is ten minutes late in a storm. The customer who should complain asks him a strange question instead.
stories.blurb_zh: 大雨天，外卖员迟到了十分钟。客户没有骂他，却问了一个奇怪的问题。

stories.title: 宋定伯卖鬼
stories.title_en: The Boy Who Sold a Ghost
stories.blurb_en: A young man meets a ghost on a dark road and tells it he is a ghost too.
stories.blurb_zh: 夜里赶路碰到鬼，怎么办？宋定伯说：“真巧，我也是鬼。”

mid.title: 宋定伯卖鬼
mid.blurb_zh: 晚上一个人走路，碰到鬼怎么办？宋定伯说：“真巧，我也是鬼。”

stories.title: 十八年的灯
stories.blurb_en: The day after the last child marries, Shen Lian hands back the household keys and asks to leave for a nunnery.
stories.blurb_zh: 最小的孩子成亲的第二天，沈莲交出了家里所有的钥匙，说她要上山去住。
chapter_titles: 第一章 二十七把钥匙
第三章 第三百级台阶

stories.title: 电梯里的纸条
stories.blurb_en: Every Monday a handwritten note appears in the lift, and it is always right. Who is writing them?
stories.blurb_zh: 每个星期一，电梯里都会出现一张手写的纸条，而且每次都说对。是谁写的？

mid.title: 电梯里的纸条
mid.blurb_zh: 每个星期一，电梯里都会出现一张手写的纸条，而且每次都说对。是谁写的？

stories.title: 借我一百天
stories.blurb_en: A clockmaker's apprentice in Tang Chang'an repairs a water clock and wakes a musician who has slept for a century. She has a hundred days.
stories.blurb_zh: 长安的一个钟匠学徒修好了一座水钟，叫醒了一个睡了一百年的乐师。水流完以前，她只有一百天。

stories.title: 精卫填海
stories.title_en: The Little Bird Who Fought the Sea
stories.blurb_en: A small bird decides to fill the whole ocean, one stone at a time.
stories.blurb_zh: 一只小鸟决定把大海填平，一次只带一块石头。

mid.title: 精卫填海
mid.blurb_zh: 一只小鸟决定把大海填平，一次只带一块石头。

stories.title: 夸父追日
stories.title_en: The Giant Who Chased the Sun
stories.blurb_en: A giant tries to catch the sun so his people will never be cold again.
stories.blurb_zh: 一个巨人想抓住太阳，让族人不再挨冻。

stories.title: 实验室的灯
stories.blurb_en: A student with a hard life at home is helped by her physics teacher, who keeps a careful line. Ten years later they meet again as equals.
stories.blurb_zh: 高中的时候，一位物理老师帮了她，也一直守着一条线。十年以后，他们又见面了。

stories.title: 李寄斩蛇
stories.title_en: The Girl Who Hunted the Serpent
stories.blurb_en: Nine girls have gone into the cave and none came back. The tenth brings a sword, a dog and some rice cakes.
stories.blurb_zh: 九个女孩进了山洞，没有一个回来。第十个女孩带了一把剑、一条狗和一堆米糕。

mid.title: 李寄斩蛇
mid.blurb_zh: 九个女孩进了山洞，没有一个回来。第十个女孩带了一把剑、一条狗和很多米糕。

stories.title: 孟姜女哭长城
stories.blurb_en: A wife's grief brings down the Great Wall, and a legend that took 2,000 years to grow.
stories.blurb_zh: 一个妻子的眼泪哭倒了长城，这个传说用了两千年才长成今天的样子。
chapter_titles: 第一章 葫芦里的女孩

stories.title: 冰箱里的小偷
stories.blurb_en: Someone keeps drinking Xiao Zhou's yogurt from the office fridge. Then the thief starts leaving money.
stories.blurb_zh: 公司冰箱里的酸奶总是不见。奇怪的是，后来小偷开始给钱了。

mid.title: 冰箱里的小偷
mid.blurb_zh: 公司冰箱里的酸奶总是不见。奇怪的是，后来小偷开始给钱了。

stories.title: 桃太郎
stories.blurb_en: Japan's favourite folk tale: a boy born from a peach sets out to beat the demons.
stories.blurb_zh: 日本最有名的民间故事：从桃子里出生的男孩去鬼岛打鬼。

stories.title: 前任是我的客户
stories.blurb_en: A consultant must rescue a failing start-up. Its founder is the man she left five years ago, and someone inside is stealing.
stories.blurb_zh: 咨询顾问许安然要救一家快倒闭的公司。创始人是她五年前离开的人，而公司里有人在偷钱。
chapter_titles: 第一章 很高兴认识您

stories.title: 联想推出外骨骼机器人，首发价6999元
stories.title_en: Lenovo launches a wearable exoskeleton robot
stories.blurb_en: Lenovo's Lecoo brand is selling a 1.8 kg exoskeleton that helps you walk, for 6,999 yuan.
stories.blurb_zh: 一个穿在身上、帮人走路更省力的机器人，只要七千元。

stories.title: 华为发布折叠手机Mate X8，12999元起
stories.title_en: Huawei launches Mate X8 foldable from 12,999 yuan
stories.blurb_en: Huawei launched the Mate X8 foldable, its thinnest yet, with a Kirin 9050 Pro chip, starting at 12,999 yuan.
stories.blurb_zh: 华为推出最薄的折叠手机Mate X8，12999元起。

stories.title: 百度开源文心5.5 Flash Preview
stories.blurb_en: Baidu open-sourced ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280B-parameter MoE model with mixed benchmark results.
stories.blurb_zh: 百度开源了文心5.5 Flash Preview大模型。

stories.title: 抖音推出门店AI一体机“豆糕”
stories.title_en: Douyin quietly launches "Dougao" AI terminal for local stores
stories.blurb_en: Douyin Life Services launched Dougao, a dual-screen AI device for stores that handles livestreaming, coupon redemption, payments and voice queries, now in 8 Chinese cities.
stories.blurb_zh: 抖音推出给门店用的AI一体机豆糕，能直播、验券和收钱。

stories.title: 小鹏IRON机器人明年先去门店当导购
stories.title_en: Xpeng's IRON robot to start as a store guide next year
stories.blurb_en: Xpeng says its IRON humanoid robot will enter mass production in January 2027, intern as a sales guide in its Chinese stores in Q1, and launch officially in Q2 2027.
stories.blurb_zh: 小鹏机器人IRON明年先进门店实习，第二季度正式发布。

stories.title: 商汤开源生图模型SenseNova U1.6
stories.title_en: SenseTime open-sources image model SenseNova U1.6
stories.blurb_en: SenseTime open-sourced SenseNova U1.6, an image model with self-correction for text errors and 10% better aesthetics than U1.5.
stories.blurb_zh: 商汤开源新生图模型，能自己检查并修改图里的错字。

stories.title: 蛮啾新游戏《蓝色星原：旅谣》公测
stories.title_en: Manjuu's new RPG Azure Promilia launches open beta
stories.blurb_en: Manjuu opened the public beta of its fantasy RPG on five platforms, with over 25 million pre-registrations worldwide.
stories.blurb_zh: 蛮啾新游戏今天公测，全球预约超过2500万。

stories.title: 支付宝车载助手3.0上车，80多个汽车品牌合作
stories.title_en: Alipay's in-car assistant 3.0 signs on 80+ car brands
stories.blurb_en: Alipay launched its AI in-car assistant 3.0, which lets drivers order and pay by voice, with over 80 car brands signed on.
stories.blurb_zh: 支付宝发布车载助手3.0，在车里说句话就能下单付钱。
title_tokens: zhī fù bǎo chē zài zhù shǒu

stories.title: DeepSeek让用户看到每次对话的“价格”
stories.title_en: DeepSeek now shows users what each chat would cost
stories.blurb_en: DeepSeek's app now shows the token use and API-price cost of each chat, while it tightens free-user limits and keeps cutting API prices.
stories.blurb_zh: DeepSeek的App开始显示每次对话用了多少Token、值多少钱。

stories.title: 最后一班地铁
stories.blurb_en: Two people fall asleep on the last metro every night, so they make a deal: one sleeps, one stays awake.
stories.blurb_zh: 两个总是坐过站的人在末班地铁上约好：一个睡觉，一个负责叫醒对方。

mid.title: 最后一班地铁
mid.blurb_zh: 两个总是坐过站的人在最后一班地铁上说好：一个睡觉，一个叫醒对方。

stories.title: 牛郎织女
stories.title_en: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl
stories.blurb_en: A poor cowherd, a weaver from heaven, and a bridge of birds that appears once a year.
stories.blurb_zh: 穷苦的放牛郎爱上天上的织女，每年只能在鹊桥上见一次面。
chapter_titles: 第一章 会说话的老牛
第二章 一条银河，一座鹊桥

stories.title: 两碗面
stories.blurb_en: A widower orders two bowls of noodles every Thursday. The woman who runs the shop has rules about waste.
stories.blurb_zh: 每个星期四，他都点两碗面，一碗自己吃，一碗放着。老板娘看不下去了。

mid.title: 两碗面
mid.blurb_zh: 每个星期四，他都点两碗面，一碗自己吃，一碗放着。老板看不下去了。

stories.title: 只有你
stories.blurb_en: Four photographs end an engagement. The bride could have proved they were false, but he never asked her.
stories.blurb_zh: 四张照片毁了一场婚约。她本来可以证明照片是假的，可是他没有问。

stories.title: 家长签名
stories.blurb_en: After her husband dies, his younger brother helps her raise the twins. Every school form has a line he does not know how to fill in.
stories.blurb_zh: 丈夫去世以后，小叔子帮她照顾双胞胎。学校的每一张表上，都有一栏他不知道怎么填。
chapter_titles: 第二章 说出来的人

stories.title: 秦始皇：第一个皇帝
stories.blurb_en: A hostage boy becomes king at 13, unites China, and then tries to live forever.
stories.blurb_zh: 做过人质的男孩，十三岁当上国王，统一了中国，又想长生不老。
chapter_titles: 第一章 人质的儿子
第二章 荆轲的匕首

stories.title: 屈原与端午节
stories.title_en: Qu Yuan and the Dragon Boat Festival
stories.blurb_en: Why do people eat zongzi and race dragon boats? Meet the poet nobody listened to.
stories.blurb_zh: 为什么端午节要吃粽子、划龙舟？认识一位没人听他劝的诗人。

stories.title: 赤壁：一把火
stories.blurb_en: A huge northern army, thousands of seasick soldiers, and a letter that was almost too good to be true.
stories.blurb_zh: 曹操的大军到了长江边，士兵们却在晕船。这时，他收到了一封投降信。

mid.title: 赤壁：一把火
mid.blurb_zh: 曹操带着很多兵到了长江边，士兵们却在船上吐。这时，他收到了一封信。

stories.title: 一封没有发出去的辞职信
stories.blurb_en: He hits "send" on his resignation letter. It goes to all 400 people in the company.
stories.blurb_zh: 他写好辞职信，一按发送，发给了全公司四百个人。

mid.title: 一封没有发出去的辞职信
mid.blurb_zh: 他写好一封信，说自己不想干了。一点“发送”，发给了全公司四百个人。

stories.title: 山海经里的奇怪国家
stories.title_en: Strange Lands in the Classic of Mountains and Seas
stories.blurb_en: Giants, polite gentlemen with pet tigers, and people who never die: a 2,000-year-old travel guide.
stories.blurb_zh: 巨人、带着老虎的君子、永远不死的人：一本两千多年前的“旅游指南”。

stories.title: 苍蝇找到的凶手
stories.title_en: The Flies That Found the Killer
stories.blurb_en: A man is murdered on a country road. Seventy villagers, seventy sickles, and one clue that only flies can see.
stories.blurb_zh: 一个人死在乡间小路上。七十个村民，七十把镰刀，还有一个只有苍蝇看得见的线索。

stories.title: 雪女
stories.blurb_en: One snowy night a woman in white spares a young woodcutter, on one condition.
stories.blurb_zh: 暴风雪的晚上，白衣女子放过了年轻的樵夫，只提了一个条件。

mid.title: 雪女
mid.blurb_zh: 下大雪的晚上，白衣女人没有杀年轻人，只提了一个条件。

stories.title: 茶马古道上的信
stories.title_en: Letters on the Tea Horse Road
stories.blurb_en: In 1930s Yunnan, a tea merchant's daughter writes a caravan man's letters to his fiancée, until she learns the fiancée married long ago.
stories.blurb_zh: 三十年代的云南，茶商的女儿替一个马帮的年轻人给未婚妻写信。后来她听说，那个姑娘早就嫁人了。

stories.title: 不
stories.blurb_en: At a palace banquet the regent asks his former wife to come back, in front of everyone. She answers with one word.
stories.blurb_zh: 宫里的宴会上，摄政王当着所有人的面，求离开的妻子回来。她只回答了一个字。

stories.title: 翻译的饭桌
stories.blurb_en: Two bosses who can't stand each other, one interpreter in the middle, and a very long dinner.
stories.blurb_zh: 两个老板互相看不顺眼，中间坐着一个翻译。这顿饭，她一口也没吃上。

stories.title: 半夜两点的灯
stories.blurb_en: Every night at 2 a.m., the lights come on in an empty office. Is the 13th floor haunted? Anna investigates.
stories.blurb_zh: 每天半夜两点，空无一人的办公室总会亮起灯。十三楼闹鬼了吗？安娜决定查个清楚。
chapter_titles: 第一章 十三楼闹鬼了？

stories.title: 两面旗
stories.blurb_en: She burns the grain meant for her husband's army to save his life, and cannot tell him why. He thinks she has chosen her family over him.
stories.blurb_zh: 为了救丈夫的三万士兵，她亲手烧了送给他们的粮食，却不能告诉他为什么。

stories.title: 13号雨伞
stories.blurb_en: Two strangers share a library umbrella without ever meeting, and start leaving notes in its handle.
stories.blurb_zh: 图书馆的13号伞，两个陌生人轮流借。他们没见过面，却一直在聊天。

mid.title: 13号雨伞
mid.blurb_zh: 图书馆的13号伞，两个不认识的人都在借。他们没见过面，却一直在聊天。

stories.title: 婚礼前两个小时
stories.blurb_en: The ring vanishes from a locked hotel room. Four people had a key, and one of them hates rings.
stories.blurb_zh: 婚礼前两小时，戒指从锁着的房间里不见了。进过房间的，只有四个人。

mid.title: 婚礼前两个小时
mid.blurb_zh: 离婚礼还有两个小时，戒指从关着门的房间里不见了。进过房间的，只有四个人。

stories.title: 周报
stories.blurb_en: Nobody reads the weekly reports, so Lin Xiao starts writing about dinosaurs in hers.
stories.blurb_zh: 没有人看周报。林晓不信，就在周报里写了一只恐龙。

mid.title: 周报
mid.blurb_zh: 没有人看周报。林晓不信，就在周报里写了一只恐龙。

stories.title: 白蛇传
stories.blurb_en: She is kind, pretty and a wonderful doctor. She is also a thousand-year-old snake.
stories.blurb_zh: 她又善良又漂亮，还会看病。只是，她是一条修炼了一千年的蛇。

stories.title: 我像谁
stories.blurb_en: A mathematics professor learns that her husband married her for her face. Then she finds she is pregnant, and his ex comes home.
stories.blurb_zh: 数学教授苏然结婚以后才知道，丈夫娶她，是因为她长得像另外一个人。

stories.title: 打错的电话
stories.blurb_en: A grandmother keeps calling the wrong number, and the young woman who answers can't bring herself to say so.
stories.blurb_zh: 一位奶奶总是打错电话，把她当成孙子的女朋友。她不忍心说破。

mid.title: 打错的电话
mid.blurb_zh: 一位奶奶总是打错电话，以为接电话的人是孙子的女朋友。她不好意思说不是。

stories.title: 武则天：唯一的女皇帝
stories.title_en: Wu Zetian, the Only Empress to Rule Alone
stories.blurb_en: A palace girl with three tools for taming a horse ends up ruling China, and leaves a blank tombstone.
stories.blurb_zh: 她说驯马只要三样东西。后来她当上了皇帝，死后留下一块没有字的碑。

mid.title: 武则天：唯一的女皇帝
mid.blurb_zh: 她说管一匹马只要三样东西。后来她当上了皇帝，死后留下一块没有字的石碑。

stories.title: 玄奘西行
stories.blurb_en: The real monk behind Journey to the West: no monkey king, just a desert, a horse and 17 years.
stories.blurb_zh: 《西游记》里唐僧的原型：没有孙悟空，只有沙漠、一匹老马和十七年。
chapter_titles: 第二章 沙漠里的五天
第三章 十七年，五万里

stories.title: 不伤心的哭声
stories.blurb_en: A governor hears a widow crying by the road and knows, before seeing anything, that something is wrong.
stories.blurb_zh: 路边有个女人在哭丈夫。官员严遵只听了一会儿，就叫人停车。

stories.title: 张县令烧猪破案
stories.title_en: The Magistrate Who Burned Two Pigs
stories.blurb_en: A husband dies in a house fire. Accident or murder? A clever magistrate finds the clue nobody else saw.
stories.blurb_zh: 丈夫死在一场大火里，是意外还是谋杀？县令发现了一个别人都没注意到的线索。
chapter_titles: 第一章 一场深夜的大火
第二章 两头猪的实验

stories.title: 郑和与“麒麟”
stories.blurb_en: In 1415 an animal nobody had ever seen arrived in China. The whole court thought it was a unicorn.
stories.blurb_zh: 一四一五年，一头谁都没见过的动物来到中国，大家都说它是神兽麒麟。

mid.title: 郑和与“麒麟”
mid.blurb_zh: 一四一五年，一只谁都没见过的动物来到中国，大家都说它就是书上的麒麟。
